works.intro: Below are selected projects I have worked on over the past few years, featuring both personal designs and corporate client work. Each project presents a unique challenge, yet they all share a consistent approach: trusting the process while staying creatively flexible. The goal is always to deliver optimal design solutions that fully satisfy the brief and meet the project timeline.

about.bio:
I am Quỳnh Anh, a Senior Graphic Designer and Visual Artist specializing in brand identity, social media design, print, digital illustration, and creative advertising. I believe every project has its own unique "personality."

Whether collaborating with corporate brands or individuals, I adapt flexibly while staying true to my signature style: modern, clean, and spacious. My design highlight is the balance between neat layouts and a playful approach to colors and patterns.

Every visual element I choose aims to guide the viewer's emotions, creating striking yet highly accessible designs that help the message connect naturally and memorably.
